contract.task_clause:
Identify the conclusion of the following argument. The sense of a term is supposed to determine its reference. But reference can vary without any difference in thought. So, the senses of terms must be able to vary without variation in thought. So, our thoughts do not determine the meanings of our terms; meanings are not in the head. (Hilary Putnam)
Option A: The sense of a term is supposed to determine its reference.
Option B: But reference can vary without any difference in thought.
Option C: Reference can vary without any difference in thought.
Option D: Our thoughts do not determine the meanings of our terms; meanings are not in the head.
